summary: Extends DHCPv6 Leasequery so a requestor can receive a continuous stream of binding updates from a server rather than only data from before the request. It allows real-time transfer of lease information to external systems.

eli5.summary: Instead of asking the librarian who borrowed each book again and again, you get a message whenever one is checked out.

questions: how to get real-time dhcpv6 binding updates
